metric_definitions.cer: Character error rate of the transcript against the source, punctuation removed.
metric_definitions.duration_ratio: duration_s divided by the nominal duration of the sentence at rate 1.0.
metric_definitions.duration_s: Audio duration measured from the WAV frame count and header sample rate.
metric_definitions.peak_memory_mb: Peak Python heap allocation during one render (tracemalloc). Best effort: native allocations inside ONNX Runtime are not attributed. With --memory-mode rss this is the process high-water RSS instead, which is not per-render.
metric_definitions.prosody_adherence: measured_rate / requested_rate, where measured_rate = base_duration / requested_duration. 1.0 means the engine honoured the rate exactly; ~0.67 means a 1.5x request was ignored.
metric_definitions.rtf: Real-time factor: audio seconds produced per wall-clock synthesis second. Higher is faster; 1.0 is real time.
metric_definitions.speaker_consistency_mean: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between the speaker embeddings of repeated renders of the same voice and text. 1.0 means a perfectly stable voice.
metric_definitions.speaker_consistency_min: Worst pairwise cosine similarity across the repeated renders.
metric_definitions.ttfa_s: Time to the first streamed audio chunk, measured on the streaming path. Kokoro streams a sentence at a time, so this is the latency to the first sentence, not to the first word.
metric_definitions.wer: Word error rate of the local STT transcript against the corpus sentence, after Unicode NFKC normalisation, case folding and punctuation removal. For Japanese/Chinese the tokens are characters, so WER equals a character-level rate there; prefer `cer`.

speaker_embedder.note: log-mel statistics over repeated renders; a stability proxy for one engine/voice, not a biometric speaker-verification model
